description_excerpt: Job Description Get to know the team The Vietnam Mobility Marketing team gets millions of people moving with Grab every day, across GrabBike, GrabCar and other ride options. We work alongside Operations, GIP, Business Development, Product and Analytics to win riders in both big cities and fast-growing provinces. We move fast: we test on the ground, read the data and scale what works. We compete hard in a crowded market, and our work directly grows Grab's share in Vietnam.
